segments.description: Opening logo graphic overlaid on pasta machine footage.
Jamie Oliver and his son introduce making pasta together in the kitchen.
Close-up shot of pouring flour onto a wooden board.
Jamie explains basic pasta ingredients.
Close-up shot of hand making a well in the flour.
Jamie asks his son Buddy about the ingredient ratio.
Close-up of Buddy answering.
Jamie cracks an egg into the flour well.
Close-up of fork mixing egg and flour.
Quick reaction shot of Buddy.
Close-up shot continuing to mix dough with a fork.
Jamie explains why using a fork helps keep hands clean.
Close-up of dough coming together.
Jamie instructing Buddy to take over kneeling.
Close-up shot of Buddy watching his dad.
Buddy starts kneading the dough with Jamie's guidance.
Detailed close-up shot of hands kneading the pasta dough.
Jamie explaining the target texture of pasta dough.
Close-up shot of dough being kneaded.
Jamie praising Buddy's kneading technique.
Close-up shot of Buddy shaping the dough ball.
Jamie explaining how to rest dough and showing pre-made sheets.
Close-up of sheet of pasta dough.
Feeding pasta sheet into pasta roller.
Close-up of pasta sheet entering the roller machine.
Rolling pasta dough thinner and longer with hand crank.
Close-up of Buddy listening to Jamie.
Jamie holding long sheet of rolled pasta.
Buddy explaining why making pasta is fun.
Jamie demonstrating different pasta shapes like lasagna sheets and farfalle.
Close-up of Buddy nod-acknowledging.
Jamie trimming pasta sheets with a knife.
Close-up of knife cutting pasta sheet.
Jamie feeding pasta sheet into cutting attachment.
Close-up shot of pasta cutter making thin tagliolini strands.
Jamie explaining thin pasta types.
Close-up of tagliolini emerging from cutter.
Wrap-up in kitchen and final brand logo overlay.

hook.opening_visual: Close-up shot of a pasta roller machine extruding fresh dough with 'Jamie Oliver' logo text overlay.
hook.opening_line: So, me and my best mate here, Buddy, we're making some pasta.
hook.notes: Introduces Jamie and his son starting a cooking demonstration.
